text: 석탄 1개 철 2개 주워서 화로 주변에 나둬
judge_rationale: The robot only picked up one iron instead of two, and kept the items in its inventory rather than placing them near the furnace.
There is no cart in the environment to go around, and the robot remained stationary at its initial position.
The robot moved from its initial position to a location very close to Cart_01 (distance reduced from 24.7m to 1.4m), successfully completing the 'go to cart' command.
